<b>Wingmoulds</b> are [[Wingmould (Hollow Knight)|returning]] [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are constructs once found in [[Hallownest]]'s [[White Palace]], now seen only in [[Red Memory|Hornet's memory]].

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Floats in place, dealing damage upon contact. Splits apart when hit, before reforming and regaining all health. While in this state, it does not deal contact damage, nor can it be attacked.

Wingmoulds can be used as pseudo-platforms that Hornet can Needle bounce off of or use the [[Clawline]] to reach. Hornet can traverse distances without risk of them becoming unavailable since they cannot be permanently killed.

== Location ==
Wingmoulds can only be found in certain sections of the [[Red Memory]] after obtaining 3 [[Old Hearts]] and returning to the [[Snail Shamans (Silksong)|Snail Shamans]].

== Trivia ==
* Wingmoulds do not respond to the [[Needolin]].
* The Wingmoulds, alongside the [[Void Tendrils (Silksong)|Void Tendrils]] and [[Shadow Creeper (Silksong)|Shadow Creepers]], are one of the 3 [[Enemies (Silksong)|Enemies]] that first appeared in <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i>.
